guide: Open Start and type your business name, your reply target, the margin you add on cost and the date of your next rate rise in the yellow cells.
Check Vehicle Classes, Seasons, Add-ons, Delivery Zones and Channels: they hold the daily rates, deposits, multipliers and fees every quote uses.
Open Rate Card and Cost per Day by Class. Type your own cost per rented day and the floor price of each class is worked out.
Log every enquiry in Enquiries with the source, the class wanted, the dates, the quote and the hours to the first reply.
Add each quote you send to Quote Log and read the verdict: above floor, thin margin or below floor.
List the quotes still open in Open Quotes and call the one ranked first.
Update Funnel by Month each month with the totals of the month so conversion and reply hours stay current.
Keep Add-on Lines up to date, then rank add-ons in Add-on Profit and use the Upsell Target.
Use the Instant Quote Builder for every quote and the Price Match Test when a renter shows a lower price.
Use the 18 calculators for pricing decisions, print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details written in.
Read the Quotes Dashboard and the Charts sheet every week: conversion, reply hours, lost enquiries, add-ons and open quotes.
A one-car host can use the same sheets with one class and one channel and delete the rows that do not apply.

listing.title: Car Rental Quotes and Rate Card Excel Template: Enquiry Log, Cost Floor Price, Seasonal Rates, Add-on Profit, Lost Enquiries
listing.headline: Quote every rental at a price that clears your cost and win more enquiries
listing.description:
Run the pricing and enquiry side of a small car or van rental in one Excel workbook. Built for an owner-operator and a manager who answer enquiries, send quotes and keep a rate card by class, plan and season. Enquiries logs every enquiry with its source, class wanted, dates, quote and hours to the first reply, and works out the reply band and a weekend flag. Quote Log sets every quote against the floor price for the stay and gives a verdict. Rate Card holds the daily, weekly and monthly rate of every class against last year with the day equivalent and the rise. Cost per Day by Class turns your loan, insurance, upkeep, cleaning, energy and depreciation into a cost per rented day and a floor price.

Season Calendar and Month Seasonality show multipliers, holiday periods and event weekends. Add-on Lines and Add-on Profit rank add-ons by profit per line. Funnel by Month, Lost Reasons, Source Conversion, Reply Time Bands, Open Quotes, Discount Steps and Weekday Demand show where enquiries are won and lost.

18 calculators answer weekly questions with a clear verdict: the instant quote, the cost floor, the seasonal rate check, the weekly and monthly discount step, the add-on ranking, the upsell target, the young-driver fee, the funnel, lost enquiries, reply time, sources, follow-ups, price match, rate rise, long hire, minimum days and a four-week forecast. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to renters, corporate accounts, a hotel partner, marketplace support, the owner, the manager, the accountant and the bookkeeper.

This is part one of the Car Rental Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Renters appear by first name and initial only. It helps you keep track of your pricing and does not promise results. Check your local rules and your insurance terms; confirm tax questions with your adviser.
